app.title: Gebeta
app.tagline: The Ethiopian game of stones and holes

about.title: About Gebeta · ገበጣ
about.p1: Gebeta is played across Ethiopia. In the 12-hole version there are two rows of six holes, one row for each player.
about.p2: Children scoop the holes into the earth and play with small pebbles, four in every hole to start.
about.p3: You sow the stones around the board one by one. Stones are taken in fours, and four stones together are called a ቤት (bet, “home”).

noWebgl.title: This device can’t show the 3D board
noWebgl.body: Gebeta needs WebGL 2, which this browser doesn’t offer. Try an up-to-date Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox.
